l4_steps.name: Member Initiates Redemption via Digital Channel
l4_steps.system: Airline Mobile App / Web Self-Service Portal
l4_steps.input: Member login session, desired award type (flight, ancillary, partner)
l4_steps.output: Redemption request record with member ID, award category, and travel dates
l4_steps.kpi: Digital channel redemption rate ≥85% of all award transactions
l4_steps.pain_point: Session timeout during multi-step redemption causes abandoned requests; no mid-session save capability in legacy web portals

l4_steps.name: Validate Member Account Status & Tier
l4_steps.kpi: Account validation response time <2 seconds (99th percentile)
l4_steps.pain_point: Members with disputed fraud flags are incorrectly blocked; manual review queue SLA averages 4 business days, causing member complaints

l4_steps.name: Verify Miles Balance Sufficiency
l4_steps.input: Current miles balance, requested award miles cost
l4_steps.output: Balance sufficiency flag; shortfall amount if insufficient
l4_steps.kpi: Real-time balance accuracy ≥99.95% (no stale cache reads)
l4_steps.pain_point: Miles balance caching latency of up to 15 minutes causes members to see inflated balances post-accrual, leading to failed redemption attempts at checkout

l4_steps.name: Query Award Seat Inventory in PSS
l4_steps.input: Requested flight, cabin class, travel dates
l4_steps.output: Award availability response (available classes and seat counts)
l4_steps.kpi: Award seat search response time <3 seconds; award seat availability ≥10% of total cabin capacity on published routes
l4_steps.pain_point: Award inventory buckets are statically defined and rarely recalibrated; high-demand routes show zero award availability 6+ months out despite low commercial load

l4_steps.name: Apply Award Inventory Control Rules
l4_steps.input: Current commercial load factor, award bucket thresholds, blackout calendar
l4_steps.output: Approved or blocked award seat release decision
l4_steps.kpi: Award inventory utilisation rate ≥72% of allocated buckets per quarter
l4_steps.pain_point: Blackout date logic is manually maintained in a spreadsheet outside the RM system; discrepancies between RM rules and loyalty portal display cause member-facing availability errors

l4_steps.name: Check Partner Award Availability
l4_steps.system: NDC API Gateway / Partner Redemption API
l4_steps.input: Partner category (hotel, car hire, retail voucher), member request
l4_steps.output: Partner award catalogue response with availability and miles cost
l4_steps.kpi: Partner API availability ≥99.5% uptime; catalogue refresh latency <24 hours
l4_steps.pain_point: Partner APIs use non-standard schemas; mapping failures cause 3–5% of partner redemption requests to error silently without member notification

l4_steps.name: Hold Award Seat or Partner Slot
l4_steps.input: Confirmed award availability, member session token
l4_steps.kpi: Hold-to-booking conversion rate ≥78%; hold timeout abandonment rate <22%
l4_steps.pain_point: 15-minute TTL is insufficient for members using screen readers or with accessibility needs; no TTL extension capability exists in the current PSS configuration

l4_steps.name: Calculate Miles Required & Applicable Taxes
l4_steps.input: Award type, cabin class, route, tier status, active promotions
l4_steps.output: Final miles cost breakdown and cash surcharge/tax amount
l4_steps.kpi: Pricing calculation accuracy 100% (zero mis-priced awards issued)
l4_steps.pain_point: Government-imposed departure taxes and carrier surcharges are inconsistently applied to award tickets; manual overrides required for certain markets increase processing time by 40%

l4_steps.name: Collect Cash Co-Pay for Taxes & Surcharges
l4_steps.input: Calculated cash amount, member payment credentials
l4_steps.kpi: Payment authorisation success rate ≥97.5%; fraud decline rate <0.8%
l4_steps.pain_point: PCI-DSS tokenisation scope forces redirect to external payment page, breaking the redemption flow and increasing cart abandonment by an estimated 12%

l4_steps.name: Member Confirms Award Booking
l4_steps.system: Airline Mobile App / Web Self-Service Portal
l4_steps.input: Full award summary, payment confirmation, miles cost
l4_steps.kpi: Confirmation completion rate ≥80% of members who reach review screen
l4_steps.pain_point: Members presented with unexpected surcharge totals at confirmation abandon at a 35% rate; no pre-checkout surcharge estimate is shown earlier in the funnel

l4_steps.name: Deduct Miles from Member Account
l4_steps.input: Member confirmation event, calculated miles cost
l4_steps.output: Updated miles balance; deduction transaction record
l4_steps.kpi: Miles deduction posting time <5 seconds; deduction error rate <0.01%
l4_steps.pain_point: Concurrent redemption requests from the same account (e.g., via app and web simultaneously) can cause double-deduction if idempotency checks are not enforced at the API layer

l4_steps.name: Issue Award Ticket or E-Voucher
l4_steps.input: Confirmed booking PNR, deduction transaction record
l4_steps.output: Electronic ticket number (ETK) or partner voucher code
l4_steps.kpi: Ticket issuance success rate ≥99.8%; issuance time <30 seconds
l4_steps.pain_point: Award tickets on interline itineraries require manual segment-by-segment ticketing in Altéa; automation gap adds 20–45 minutes per complex itinerary and scales poorly during peak redemption periods

l4_steps.name: Transmit Partner Booking via API
l4_steps.system: NDC API Gateway / Partner Redemption API
l4_steps.input: Voucher code, partner booking reference, member contact details
l4_steps.kpi: Partner booking API success rate ≥98.5%; confirmation delivery time <2 minutes
l4_steps.pain_point: Real-time partner booking APIs cover only 60% of partners; remaining 40% use batch file exchange with 24-hour confirmation lag, leaving members without instant booking confirmation

l4_steps.name: Send E-Ticket & Booking Confirmation to Member
l4_steps.input: ETK or voucher code, partner confirmation, member contact preferences
l4_steps.output: Transactional email/SMS confirmation with PNR and redemption summary
l4_steps.kpi: Confirmation delivery rate ≥99.2%; delivery time <5 minutes of ticket issuance
l4_steps.pain_point: Members who update contact preferences in the loyalty portal mid-session may receive confirmations to a stale email address due to CRM sync latency of up to 6 hours

l4_steps.name: Update Member Redemption History
l4_steps.input: Completed transaction record, ETK, partner reference
l4_steps.output: Updated member activity ledger; redemption event record
l4_steps.kpi: Ledger update latency <10 seconds; history record accuracy 100%
l4_steps.pain_point: Partner redemption events written by the NDC gateway use a different transaction format than PSS award tickets; consolidation into a single view requires nightly batch job, preventing real-time statement accuracy

l4_steps.name: Reconcile Miles Deducted vs Tickets Issued
l4_steps.input: Daily miles deduction log, ticket issuance log, partner voucher log
l4_steps.output: Reconciliation report; exception list of unmatched transactions
l4_steps.kpi: Reconciliation match rate ≥99.9%; exception resolution within 2 business days
l4_steps.pain_point: Ticketing system and loyalty ledger use different timestamps (UTC vs local departure time); timezone mismatch causes ~0.3% of daily transactions to appear as exceptions requiring manual investigation

l4_steps.name: Report Liability Reduction to Finance
l4_steps.input: Reconciled redemption volume, miles deducted, average CPM (cost per mile)
l4_steps.output: Loyalty liability journal entry; deferred revenue release posting
l4_steps.kpi: Monthly loyalty liability reporting accuracy ±0.5% variance vs actuals; posted within 3 business days of month-end
l4_steps.pain_point: CPM (cost per mile) used for liability valuation is updated quarterly; interim month fluctuations in redemption mix (premium vs economy) create material variance in reported liability that is not visible until quarter-end

l4_steps.name: Analyse Redemption Patterns for Programme Optimisation
l4_steps.system: Tableau / Power BI (connected to AWS Redshift)
l4_steps.input: Redemption history, award category breakdown, tier segment data
l4_steps.output: Redemption analytics dashboard; programme adjustment recommendations
l4_steps.kpi: Award seat utilisation rate ≥75%; partner redemption share ≥20% of total redemptions
l4_steps.pain_point: Redemption data from partner ecosystems arrives with 48-hour delay and inconsistent granularity; analytics dashboards cannot provide same-day programme performance visibility needed for dynamic award pricing decisions
